data_objects.name: partitioned_mob3_scores
data_objects.meaning: Dated score records with optional split assignment and an optional three-month outcome label.

variables.name: uniq_id
variables.meaning: Opaque record identifier; values include a long hash-like component and a date-like suffix.

variables.name: split_flag
variables.meaning: Nullable partition code with observed nonblank values 1.train, 2.valid, and 3.oot.

variables.name: score
variables.meaning: Continuous model score on an undocumented scale.

variables.name: apply_date
variables.meaning: Application calendar date encoded as YYYYMMDD.

variables.name: raw_label_mob3
variables.meaning: Nullable binary 0.0/1.0 raw outcome labeled for a three-month-on-book horizon by the column name.

structure.description: Each row is one scored application record. split_flag provides train, validation, and out-of-time groupings where present.

uncertainties: The positive-class event and score calibration are not defined.
Rows with blank split_flag also have blank raw_label_mob3, but the source does not explain this subset.
annotation_notes: Blank split and label fields are true missing values, not additional string categories.
